title: Commitment benefit at different utilization
method: Synthetic fixed-rate example, not provider pricing. Commitment $0.70/hour versus $1/hour on demand. The last bar is additional cost, not saving: $0.70 minus $0.60. Break-even utilization is 70%.
alt: Commitment benefit at different utilization. 100% utilization saving: 0.3 USD/hour; 80% utilization saving: 0.1 USD/hour; 60% utilization unused: 0.1 USD/hour. Illustrative values.
